title: Necrosis Detection in Meningioma Images
summary: IIIT Bangalore presents a computational-pathology pipeline for necrosis detection, with clinical decision support as its intended application.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Researchers describe a machine-learning pipeline that detects necrosis in meningioma images under limited-data conditions. It runs on university servers and is presented as promising computational-neuropathology research. Deployment improvements, comparative diagnostic effects, and patient outcomes are unreported.
purpose: Assist pathological identification of necrotic tissue.

ratings.reason: University-hosted necrosis detection has been tested under limited-data conditions. Clinical workflow improvements remain undocumented.
No patient diagnosis or treatment outcome is documented.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 11: Necrosis Detection in Meningioma Images

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: Machine learning identifies necrosis in meningioma images
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
